reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.comment: Awesome case & hardware, I even bought a 2nd case.
reviews.author: Sonny G TX

reviews.title: Good but......
reviews.comment: Super Quite Fans!!! RGB works nicely with my AMD mother board. My only complaint is, as a few others have noted.....Some of the standoffs are stripped so you may not be able to use all the screws to hold down your motherboard. I built two computers with this tower and both had the same issue. I was tempted to return it but decided to over look this flaw because I really like the case. I had specific needs and this one fit my needs just fine. I would buy again even with the know issue. The issue might be significant to others which is why this got a 3 star instead of a five star review.
reviews.author: K. Thibault

reviews.title: 80% Work But Light Controller Failed
reviews.comment: Most of the parts are functional except the light controller. The cable for controlling or the part responsible for controlling just does not work. And this controller is the main reason I bought this case otherwise I can get cheaper cases so will just give 2 stars. Luckily the motherboard I bought gives a splitter which allows me to control the lights via software so didn’t return it.
reviews.author: ShelbyZ
